title: Children Concepts
description: Canonical children concepts for reviewer reasoning.

entries.title: Child
entries.description: A child as a protected minor.

entries.title: Infant
entries.description: A very young child requiring special protection.

entries.title: Teenager
entries.description: An adolescent child or young person.

entries.title: Minor
entries.description: A person below the legal age of adulthood.

entries.title: Disabled Child
entries.description: A child with a disability or additional support need.

entries.title: Disabled Adult
entries.description: An adult with a disability requiring dignity and protection.

entries.title: Elderly Person
entries.description: An older person who may be vulnerable to abuse or neglect.

entries.title: Vulnerable Person
entries.description: A person whose age, disability, or circumstances increase vulnerability.

entries.title: Parent
entries.description: A parent responsible for care and protection.

entries.title: Guardian
entries.description: A legal guardian or custodian responsible for safety.

entries.title: Physical Abuse
entries.description: Physical harm or violent treatment of a child or vulnerable person.

entries.title: Psychological Abuse
entries.description: Emotional cruelty, coercion, or mental harm.

entries.title: Humiliation
entries.description: Degrading treatment or deliberate shaming.

entries.title: Bullying
entries.description: Repeated intimidation or harassment.

entries.title: Threatening
entries.description: Threats of harm, punishment, or retaliation.

entries.title: Fear Induction
entries.description: Deliberate creation of fear or terror.

entries.title: Neglect
entries.description: Failure to provide basic care or safety.

entries.title: Abandonment
entries.description: Leaving a dependent person without care or support.

entries.title: Exploitation
entries.description: Using a vulnerable person for unfair gain.

entries.title: Sexual Exploitation
entries.description: Sexual abuse or exploitation of a child or vulnerable person.

entries.title: Grooming
entries.description: Manipulative preparation of a child for exploitation.

entries.title: Human Trafficking
entries.description: Recruitment, transport, or control of a person for exploitation.

entries.title: Child Recruitment
entries.description: Recruiting a child into harmful or criminal activity.

entries.title: Forced Labor
entries.description: Compelling a person to work against their will.

entries.title: Criminal Exploitation
entries.description: Using a vulnerable person to facilitate crime.

entries.title: Mocking Disability
entries.description: Ridicule targeting disability or impairment.

entries.title: Discrimination
entries.description: Unequal or hostile treatment based on protected status.

entries.title: Isolation
entries.description: Deliberate social exclusion or separation.

entries.title: Endangerment
entries.description: Putting a vulnerable person in danger.
